title: fix(dedicated): correct burst utilization accounting & clamp autoscaler smoothing (priority routing edge-case)
author: Aisha Khan
release_notes: Fix: correct burst utilization reporting for priority-routed requests and clamp autoscaler smoothing parameters to avoid over-provisioning under queue-draining edge cases.
description: Context: Customers running Dedicated fleets with priority routing and token-bucket burst controls observed inconsistent burst utilization numbers (dashboards showed >100% briefly) and autoscaler over-reacting during rapid traffic shifts. Root cause: the utilization reporter double-counted in-flight queued tokens when priority lanes were present and the smoothing function in the autoscaler allowed a transient scaling delta larger than the configured burst_capacity, causing temporary over-provisioning. This PR: 1) fixes accounting in the utilization reporter so queued + in-flight tokens are de-duplicated for burst_utilization calculation; 2) clamps the autoscaler smoothing delta to respect burst_capacity and max_burst_slots, preventing abrupt scale-ups during queue drains; 3) adds a new Prometheus metric dedicated_fleet.burst_utilization_percent and updates labels to include priority_lane and route_group for easier querying; 4) adds unit + integration tests covering priority routing queue scenarios and e2e smoke for utilization reporting; 5) updates the dashboards and runbook snippets with the corrected metric and troubleshooting steps. Commits (summary): "fix: de-dupe queued tokens in burst reporter"; "feat(metrics): add dedicated_fleet.burst_utilization_percent"; "fix(autoscaler): clamp smoothing delta by burst_capacity"; "test: add priority-queue utilization tests"; "docs: update dashboards and runbook". Files changed (high level): src/dedicated/autoscaler/smoother.go, src/dedicated/autoscaler/smoother_test.go, src/dedicated/util/reporting.go, src/dedicated/util/reporting_test.go, telemetry/prometheus/metrics.yml, observability/dashboards/dedicated-burst.json, docs/runbooks/dedicated-burst.md, pkg/config/defaults.go. Test plan: unit tests + integration harness for priority routing were run locally and on CI; added deterministic test that simulates rapid burst then queue drain and asserts utilization <= 100% and autoscaler scale delta within configured bounds. Linear/Jira: ENG-4321 (root-cause + fix), ENG-4378 (add metric & dashboards), SUP-1287 (customer support ticket).
